subject: general
question: In April 2022, NITI Aayog and UNICEF India signed a Statement of Intent on SDGs focusing on which issue?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Children**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In April 2022, NITI Aayog and UNICEF India signed a Statement of Intent on SDGs with a focus on **children**.
 
• This collaboration aims to accelerate progress on the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) related to children’s welfare and rights.
 
• Focus areas include health, nutrition, education, and protection of children.
 
• The initiative seeks to ensure that no child is left behind and that every child has the opportunity to thrive and develop to their full potential.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) are a collection of 17 global goals set by the United Nations General Assembly in 2015 for the year 2030.
 
• They cover a broad range of social, economic, and environmental development issues.
 
• UNICEF (United Nations International Children's Emergency Fund) is a UN agency responsible for providing humanitarian and developmental aid to children worldwide.
 
• NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India) is a policy think tank of the Government of India, established to achieve sustainable development goals through cooperative federalism.
